approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would update the funding limits for Australian Research Council grant programs to account for inflation and add a new spending year.
It would change three existing annual funding amounts and set a figure for the year starting 1 July 2016.
The extra spending over four financial years would be $814.876 million.
The bill would apply indexation to funding caps for three financial years: 2013–14, 2014–15 and 2015–16.
It would add a funding figure for the financial year starting 1 July 2016.
It would increase the special appropriation available to the Australian Research Council by $814.876 million over four years.
The Australian Research Council and researchers who receive grants through the National Competitive Grants Program.
